column2: Yes. I think doing something different once in a while isn't bad.{wait}{clear}Do you have your own way of changing pace?
As a child?
What did you play when you were little?

An abrupt question, as usual.{wait}{clear}I don't have many memories of playing as a child. As soon as I was old enough to understand, I began training to be a mage while traveling...{wait}{clear}Well, back when I didn't know any better, it may have felt the same as playing.
A while longer
May I stay with you a while longer?
Sure, it's a rare chance to rest. You should take it easy too.
Another task
I know the fighting is hard, but please keep lending your strength for the people's sake.
You can be firm when it counts, can't you?{wait}{clear}I thought you were more easygoing, but I suppose there's a reason you were entrusted with guarding the world.
Rest well
At least at times like this, please get some good rest.
Yeah... I'll gladly do that... Why don't you relax a little too, ＄＄＄＄＄＄?
Your thoughts
Do you think things over while you walk?
Yeah, always... One thing after another comes to mind...
Crowded places
Do you go to places where people gather?
Sometimes. I'm not good with big crowds, but sometimes it's necessary.
Eating well?
Are you eating properly?
Yeah... I'm eating... ＄＄＄＄＄＄, you worry even about that?{wait}{clear}You worry about me too much.
Be careful
Please be careful...
Yeah...
I'm sorry
I'm sorry, but please hang in there...
Don't worry so much...
Don't overdo it
Please don't push yourself too hard.
Yeah... I know... Don't worry so much.
Stay alert
Please don't let your guard down.
Of course... No matter the enemy, I won't let my guard down.
The enemy
Aren't you concerned about the enemy?
Don't you think there's no point worrying about it at this stage?
Good luck
Please do your best...
